passage.text: My family lives in an old house in Bangkok.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈfæməli ˈlɪvz ɪn ən ˈoʊld ˈhaʊs ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: It has two floors and a small garden.
passage.reading: ɪt ˈhæz ˈtuː ˈflɔːrz ənd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈɡɑːrdən.

passage.text: My bedroom has a balcony with flowers.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈbɛdruːm ˈhæz ə ˈbælkəni wɪð ˈflaʊərz.

passage.text: But my favorite place is the roof.
passage.reading: bʌt maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈpleɪs ɪz ðə ˈruːf.

passage.text: At night, I sit there and look at the city lights.
passage.reading: ət ˈnaɪt, aɪ ˈsɪt ˈðɛr ənd ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈsɪti ˈlaɪts.
